item.title: Paid Peer Tutor Positions Available for Sophomores, Juniors, and Seniors with Flexible Hours
item.description: The CSA Tutoring Service is seeking qualified and motivated sophomores, juniors and seniors to serve as peer tutors. The position is paid and offers flexible hours based on the tutor's schedule but we prefer at least 4 hours a week. Tutors must have B+ or better in the course(s) they would like to tutor.Tutors should also have demonstrated skills including, problem-solving, critical thinking, timely email communication and attention to detail.A personal interview is required. Read about the program in the CC Bulletin and the Mendelson Center website. Questions about the application process? Contact apply@gsb.columbia.edu. General questions about the program?
